exam_name: Machine Learning for Internet of Things and Electromagnetic Field Theory
conducting_body: Veer Madho Singh Bhandari Uttarakhand Technical University
action_taken: Exam cancelled + Professor barred for 7 years + Arrests-FIR
note: The university cancelled two exams after an inquiry found that an external question paper setter had allegedly shared questions with students before one of the tests. The leaked questions were circulated through the institute's internal portal and WhatsApp before the examination.
The Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) was postponed after a paper leak was confirmed. The alleged mastermind behind the leak, Birendra Kumar Gupta, was arrested from Bihar.

Reports surfaced alleging a pharmacy exam paper leak in Punjab. A truck parked outside the exam location was found to be filled with exam helpers and several teachers, who were allegedly paid by aspirants.
